source_title: The Achilles’ heel of global trade: Building resilience where it matters most
figure_ref: Exhibit 3: Share of imports exposed to 2 or 3 vulnerabilities; variable-width columns
business_context: global goods import risk and supply chain resilience
key_message: 일본 수입의 36%가 복합 무역취약성에 노출되는 반면 말레이시아는 10%이며, 실제 경제적 위험은 취약 비율뿐 아니라 수입 규모·치명도·회복수단으로 판단해야 한다.
insight_type: exposure layers and import-weighted country comparison

encoding.x: economy sorted by exposure, column width imports_usd_billion

data_spec.unit: percentage of goods imports by economy; total imports $bn (nominal USD, 2024)
data_spec.denominator: total import value for each economy in 2024; Europe-30 excludes intra-bloc
data_spec.sample_and_model: UN Comtrade; MGI vulnerability model, product criticality/concentration/geopolitical distance

data_recipe: Normalize country and year total nominal goods imports
Classify products as exactly two/all three risk criteria
Derive two-only by total minus all-three (rounding-aware)
Map import value to column width and vulnerability shares to stacked height
Review physical chokepoints and substitute suppliers before acting
message_conditions: Derived exactly_two_pct uses already rounded reported inputs
Column widths show relative imports not loss probability
Shares apply to each economy own import base and do not establish causal losses
design_moves: variable-width stacked columns reflecting published Exhibit 3 encoding
two themes and explicit source footnote
diff_notes: Official HTML Exhibit 3 text/table and encoding checked, but original raster/PDF diagram not viewed. Structural reconstruction remains unverified.

training_pair.instruction: Create an import-weighted stacked column view for 15 economies showing exactly two versus three supply-chain vulnerabilities, with exact official inputs and source metadata.
training_pair.response: Files: chart.py rendering import-width Marimekko; data.csv includes 15 publicly reported import values and vulnerability percentages, derived exactly_two_pct; config.json defines THEME.source/neutral and CONTEXT. Run python chart.py --data data.csv --config config.json --theme source --output source.png and repeat --theme neutral.
